model_family_note: Same family as the model authoring this project (Claude Sonnet 5), chosen for consistency with the intended advanced-system model per BUGPROOF_AGENT_BRIEF.md's model-consistency requirement, and because no other provider's key was authorized for this purpose.
temperature: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
max_output_tokens: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
reasoning_effort: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
tools_available_to_subagent: all (general-purpose subagent default: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, ...)
tools_actually_needed: read files under buggy/, write one test file, run pytest at most once

attempts_per_case.D: 0, or 1 repair iff C != VERIFIED_REPRODUCTION -- never more

token_usage_note: Claude Code's Agent tool reports a single subagent_tokens total per completed subagent (not split into input/output) plus tool_uses and duration_ms; recorded verbatim in evidence/baseline/usage.json.
cost_unavailable_reason: Claude Code's Agent tool does not expose per-subagent dollar cost to the orchestrating session; not fabricated or estimated from public per-token pricing, marked unavailable in results.json instead.

ladder_rungs.A: frozen Phase 2 baseline, reused verbatim, not regenerated
ladder_rungs.B: + execute before claiming: orchestrator re-runs A's frozen candidate against buggy/ itself and computes the claim mechanically; zero new subagent calls (B's generation prompt would be byte-identical to A's)
ladder_rungs.C: + Evidence/Contract Sufficiency Gate: fresh one-shot generation with a mandatory execution report + structured EVIDENCE block; every exact contract the candidate's own code asserts is independently AST-detected and must be really grounded, regardless of how the agent labels anything
ladder_rungs.D: + bounded repair loop: reuses C's candidate; exactly one repair subagent call iff C's claim was not already VERIFIED_REPRODUCTION

evidence_gate_note: Deterministic checker in this module (check_evidence_grounding). The generating agent self-discloses evidence in its own response; nothing is re-asked of a second model. 'The goal is not to add more agents.'
claim_states_note: B has no gate step, so INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is unreachable for B by construction -- two states only. This asymmetry is intentional, not a gap.
oracle_scoring_note: evaluate() is run against every variant's final frozen candidate for every case, regardless of claim (including EXECUTION_FAILURE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE outcomes), for VRR measurement only -- as a separate, later, independent call, never the same call that fed the runtime decision.
contract_extraction_note: Corrected design (see module docstring): KIND labels alone never exempt an asserted value from grounding. extract_expected_contracts() independently AST-detects every exact ==, !=, is/is not, and pytest.raises(...) contract in the candidate's own code; each one must be matched by a verified literal quote or a verified derived (safe-arithmetic) computation, or the claim is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE regardless of how the agent labeled its evidence.

phase3_run_metadata.model_override: none -- same model/subagent_type as Phase 2 baseline (see model_family_note above)

evidence_gate_mechanism_history.round_1_defect: first design let KIND: qualitative structurally exempt an item from grounding by label alone -- an agent could dodge grounding entirely by mislabeling an invented exact value. Caught by independent review before any live subagent call.
evidence_gate_mechanism_history.round_1_fix: extract_expected_contracts() independently AST-detects every exact ==, !=, is, is not, and pytest.raises(...) contract in the candidate, regardless of EVIDENCE labeling.
evidence_gate_mechanism_history.round_2_defect: literal-only grounding had no path for legitimately DERIVED numeric values (e.g. setup numbers + a documented rate). Caught before Step 0.
evidence_gate_mechanism_history.round_2_fix: KIND: derived, checked by a hand-rolled whitelist-only safe arithmetic evaluator -- never Python eval/exec/compile.
evidence_gate_mechanism_history.round_3_note: mid-batch, before any candidate was scored: list/tuple-literal contracts (e.g. == [1, 2, 3]) were found to be silently invisible to the round-1 extractor (ast.List/ast.Tuple are not ast.Constant). Fixed via _resolve_value() before any live pipeline run; regression-tested (tests/test_advanced_gate.py::test_18).

known_scope_boundaries_disclosed_post_ru: EVIDENCE block format is fragile to honest stylistic variation (missing --- separators, field-name casing, evidence placed in trajectory.md instead of the final message) -- observed independently multiple times, see ablations/special_review.md

Comparisons against a computed (non-literal) expression, e.g. len(setup_list) or 1 + page_size, are invisible to the AST contract extractor entirely -- observed independently three times, see ablations/special_review.md
